name: Captain Africa
whyMatch: IA item 'Captain Africa: the battle for Egyptica' (Trenton, NJ: Africa World Press, 1992) — IA metadata description states it is a reprint 'Originally published: Somerville, N.J.: African Prince Productions, 1990.' Same title, same creator work (Dwayne J. Ferguson / African Prince Productions), matching NJ publisher and era in dankyNote (Glen Ridge/Somerville, African Prince Productions, 1992-1994). Downloaded the item's cover thumbnail image (full-text PDF is lending-restricted).
caption: Cover of 'Captain Africa: the Battle for Egyptica,' the 1992 Africa World Press reprint of Dwayne J. Ferguson's Captain Africa comic, originally published by African Prince Productions of Somerville/Glen Ridge, NJ.

name: Word Up!
source: Sotheby's auction listing (Art and Influence of Hip Hop, 2022)
whyMatch: Sotheby's lot photographs a physical collection of 28 issues of Word Up! magazine spanning 1987-1997, the same Paramus, NJ-headquartered hip-hop magazine (Enoble Media, publisher John Blassingame, founding editor Gerrie Summers) described in the dankyNote. High-resolution (4717x3657) auction-house photo shows actual magazine covers/spines, not a catalog record or mention.
caption: A lot of 28 issues of Word Up! magazine (1987-1997), the Paramus, NJ hip-hop teen magazine, photographed for a 2022 Sotheby's 'Art and Influence of Hip Hop' auction.
